En eventos trabajo invisible: sin interrumpir, sin

findings.fix: A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (6.8:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: No visible button in the first screen.
findings.fix: Give the one primary action a real button in the first screen (a filled or solid-bordered control, 44px or taller), not only a link in the navigation.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 1 text element(s) use mix-blend-mode difference or exclusion.
findings.fix: Over anything but black, white or grey, blended text takes random hues (blue on orange, lilac on green) that jurors read as a glitch. Use a solid ink chosen for the ground, or keep the blended text over neutral grounds only.

findings.message: No headline found in the first viewport.
findings.fix: The first screen needs a clear focal statement or image.

findings.message: 1 stretch(es) of the page hold nothing at all: 1152px at 12420px (the screen is 900px tall).
findings.fix: Close the gap: a section gap is 120–240px on desktop and 72–112px on a phone. Look for a min-height: 100vh on a short section, an empty grid row, a hidden element still holding its space, or a reveal that never fired. A deliberate rest is a placed picture or colour field, not nothing.

findings.message: The h1 ("GROOVY · PICS") is not on the first screen (it starts 932px down).
findings.fix: The title belongs on the first screen, where a visitor decides whether to stay.

findings.message: A section carries text but no heading: div at 2880px.
findings.fix: Name it with a short heading unless it is the continuation of the section above.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "STUDIO" (screen 8, 50% hidden); "DE DÍA" (screen 9, 50% hidden); "DE NOCHE" (screen 10, 50% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: Pinned large text slides across pictures while the page scrolls: "GROOVY" (screen 12, 38% over a picture); "PICS" (screen 3, 100% over a picture)
findings.fix: Jurors read a pinned title crossing drawings or photographs as a collision. Keep the pictures in the column the title does not occupy, or unpin it.

findings.message: The same large text stays on screen for 3 screens in a row: "GROOVY · PICS"
findings.fix: A pinned element earns two screens, and something must change at each. Shorten the run or give every screen its own content.

findings.message: 6 text block(s) sit 12–15px from the phone's edge: "Groovy" (16px); "Detrás del lente" (16px); "Fotógrafo de Maracay. Prefiero" (16px)
findings.fix: The page margin is 16–20px on a phone; the header and the corner labels sit on it too.
